services.name: Magic Day Camp
services.desc: Personal Benefits: Builds confidence and independence. Promotes safe and friendly social interactions, collaboration, creativity, respect, and leadership skills. Builds magic skills, presentation skills, observation skills, crafting skills, artistic skills, critical thinking skills, and deductive reasoning skills. No prior skill in magic is required. An interest in magic is highly recommended for students to fully enjoy the complete immersive magic experience. New magic materials are included: All new magic materials are included for students to use and keep. No additional fees. All inclusive in camp price. Snacks are included: Vegan, nut-free, dairy-free, wheat-free, gluten-free, non-GMO,

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Private Magic Classes for Children and Adults - For all skill levels and interests - at Brooklyn Magic Shop - Located between Cobble Hill and Carroll Gardens - in Brooklyn, New York Brooklyn Magic Shop offers patient and immersive private one-on-one magic learning experiences for children and adults of all skill-levels and ages. From beginners to advanced, classes are tailored to meet your magic needs and aspirations. Brooklyn Magic Shop's custom magic classes are perfect for those looking for a unique introduction to the art of magic or looking to dive deeper into the art. Private Magic Classes are also recommended for performing magicians who are looking to grow technique and structure.

blurb: Brooklyn Magic Shop is a small, family-owned, immersive Magic Shop and Magic Theater nestled between the family-friendly neighborhoods of Cobble Hill and Carroll Gardens in Brooklyn, New York. Brooklyn Magic Shop is a space where children and adults alike can discover and begin their magical journey.
